name: Date with a Werewolf
source:
A  date... with a werewolf? A  short cute game about an awkward first date between two long distance lovers.  Play as Emily, a young 22 year old woman looking forward to her first date with her long distance boyfriend Frazer.  Frazer has cancelled every date you've tried to schedule before this, is he hiding some terrible secret? 

[From [url=https://cici-battleaxe.itch.io/datewithawerewolf]Itch.io[/url]]
